_comment: Workspace-scoped SessionStart hook. Builds a markdown summary of git posture + bootstrap-artifact presence, then emits it as a {"systemMessage":"..."} JSON object on stdout (per the hook output spec) so the model's first turn sees it as additional system context instead of inline echo noise. Exit 0 always.

SessionStart.command: bash -c 'cd "${WORKSPACE_ROOT:-${COPILOT_HOOK_WORKSPACE_ROOT:-.}}" 2>/dev/null || true; msg="## Session Bootstrap"; if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then msg="$msg\\n- Git branch: $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)"; dirty=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); msg="$msg\\n- Dirty files: $dirty"; msg="$msg\\n- Last commit: $(git log -1 --pretty=format:"%h %s" 2>/dev/null)"; fi; mem="$HOME/.copilot/memories/session"; [[ -d "$mem" ]] || mem="./.memories/session"; if [[ -d "$mem" ]]; then for f in workspace_dossier.md team_blueprint.md feature_contract.md; do if [[ -f "$mem/$f" ]]; then msg="$msg\\n- Session artifact: $f present ($(wc -l < "$mem/$f" | tr -d " ") lines)"; else msg="$msg\\n- Session artifact: $f ABSENT"; fi; done; fi; printf %s "{\"systemMessage\":\"$msg\"}"; exit 0'
